audience: developers who build health and fitness apps on wearable data and lab tests from Vital

useCases.title: Check which wearables a user has connected
useCases.text: The AI lists the providers (wearables and data sources) one user has connected, and the latest device or app info for that user.

useCases.title: Review sleep, activity and workouts for a user
useCases.text: The AI reads sleep, activity and workout summaries for one user over a date range. It sums up the trend for you.

useCases.title: Read wearable timeseries and body summaries
useCases.text: The AI reads timeseries points for one user and one resource, such as heartrate, hrv, steps or body_weight, over a date range. It can add the body summary.

useCases.title: Find a user by id or list your team's users
useCases.text: The AI finds a Vital user by your client_user_id or by Vital user_id, and lists the users of your team.

useCases.title: Check which lab tests you offer
useCases.text: The AI lists the lab tests available to your team and opens one test for its details.

useCases.title: Create a user and a link token for a wearable
useCases.text: The AI creates a Vital user and a short-lived link token, so the user can connect a wearable or provider.
